    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BotFinished" name="Bot finished and shared"/>

        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Msg_UpdateList"/>

      <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="List updated"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="UserTask_UpdateList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="UserTask_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${bragToFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendMaterials">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="ServiceTask_Recover"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>

      <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 resources are gathered in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>

        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${selectedResourceCount}</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="ServiceTask_Gather" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_Recover" name="Recover bot after disaster"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="ServiceTask_Gather" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone" messageRef="Msg_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notified"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Brag" name="Brag"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SendMaterials" name="Send materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BotFinished" name="Bot finished and shared"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update material list" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Update requested" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Msg_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="List updated"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="UserTask_UpdateList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_2" sourceRef="UserTask_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="UserTask_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectResources" targetRef="UserTask_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="UserTask_SetUrgency" targetRef="BusinessRuleTask_CheckToolDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="BusinessRuleTask_CheckToolDependencies" targetRef="Task_CreateTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CreateTools" targetRef="ServiceTask_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="ServiceTask_StartFarming" targetRef="Gateway_Gather_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Gather_Merge" targetRef="ServiceTask_Gather"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Gather" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="UserTask_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragToFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="UserTask_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendMaterialsToFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="UserTask_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="UserTask_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="ServiceTask_Recover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="ServiceTask_Recover" targetRef="Gateway_Gather_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
